newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rotterdam bunkers up $1, rest of Europe stable.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunkers up $1, rest of Europe stable.

text.p: Rotterdam fuel oil bunkers gained about $1 on Monday as barges nudged higher, while prices in the rest of Europe were stable, dealers said.
Rotterdam bunkers were about $1 a tonne firmer at around $85 fob after barges traded at above $83 fob Rotterdam.
Bunker demand was sparse. Dealers estimates of the volume of enquiries were generally below 10,000 tonnes.
Hamburg prices were little changed. Quotes were around $90 fob. The German bunker market was also quiet.
Mediterranean fuel oil was steady. Gas oil dipped by around $1 a tonne. Only dealers in Italy reported renewed demand.
Egyptian prices barely changed. Supply in all ports was sufficient.
